note: This file contains only data variables (FREEBUILD_WITH_CORRECTION and FREEBUILD_TEMPLATES) — no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines dialogue templates for the Freebuild action in CraftAssist's generation dialogues, used to instruct an agent to complete half-built structures in a Minecraft-like environment.
FREEBUILD_WITH_CORRECTION: list of paired template objects for freebuild actions with correction, each pair has an initial template and a replacement template
FREEBUILD_TEMPLATES: list of template object sequences for freebuild actions covering location-only, block-object-only, repeat counts, and all/every quantifiers
